timing_definitions.automation_and_serialization_overhead_ms: Node page.evaluate round-trip minus browser diagnose wall time; includes IPC, payload/file preparation and result serialization, not model latency.
timing_definitions.browser_diagnose_ms: Browser performance.now() immediately before await diagnose(file) to after resolve; includes image decode/Canvas resize, model execution, tensor/output handling, and cached metadata. File construction, disk I/O, base64 encoding, and Playwright transport are excluded. First call additionally includes model download/hash/WASM import/session initialization.
timing_definitions.browser_model_execution_stage_ms: Approximate execution stage: onProgress 75% to 100%; includes tensor construction, session.run, output copying and predictionResult; excludes image decoding and session initialization. This is not a direct isolated kernel benchmark.
timing_definitions.environment_limit: Single headless Chromium process on this Cloud Linux host, with concurrent work potentially sharing CPU. No inference or deployment-performance claim for other devices.
timing_definitions.model_download_ms: PerformanceResourceTiming.duration for initial .onnx resource from request start to response end on localhost. Not internet download performance. WASM resource timing also recorded.
timing_definitions.warm_summary: First cold call excluded; 1025 remaining held-out samples in manifest order. Ten extra deterministic samples are summarized separately, not counted as additional test observations.

dataset.grouping: Rotation/mirror-canonical full-image and green-region 64-bit pHash: one distance <=4 AND both distances <=10; transitive union
limitations: Source labels inherited from publishers; no new expert diagnosis performed.
Plant and capture-session identities are incomplete; perceptual groups reduce, but cannot eliminate, all leakage.
No reliable new independent source was found for anthracnose, bird_eye_spot or white_spot; these classes are not inflated with synthetic photos.
Offline augmented sources without parent identities, ambiguous blight/rust labels, pests and non-tea leaves excluded.
Splits are new. Old accuracy values and old checkpoints do not constitute evaluation on this version.
Healthy is deliberately the largest class; use class weights and report macro metrics to account for imbalance.
dataset.reserve_reason: New healthy singleton photos retained outside training/evaluation to allow exact integer 70/15/15.

sources.citation: User-provided DuLieuGoc; related reference: Kimutai & Forster (2022), DOI 10.17632/j32xdt2ff5.2
sources.license: User-provided originals: retain their original source terms; no new license assigned here.

dataset.split_method: Exact global and floor/ceil per-class integer quotas; perceptual families assigned intact; deterministic seed 42

limitations: Internal held-out evaluation from the same source datasets; not an independent Vietnamese field trial.
Perceptual groups reduce duplicate leakage, but plant/session identifiers were not supplied for every source image.
Source labels are inherited from dataset publishers; conflicting exact duplicates are excluded rather than relabeled.
More healthy photos do not guarantee improved real-world specificity; per-class metrics are reported.

training.augmentation: 2 deterministic training-only views per original: horizontal flip, +/-15 degree rotation, brightness/contrast .85–1.15
training.feature_cache_equivalence: Backbone is frozen; train classifier on cached features, then save the complete raw-RGB-input model.
